races.name: Molson Coors Beverage Company Nursery Handicap
races.verdict: PREMIER VIEW proved transformed on the back of being gelded and being fitted with a tongue tie when going in over C&D earlier this month and can follow up now quickly pitched into nursery company off a handy-looking mark. Naas scorer Santo Parvenue rates the obvious threat despite taking an 8 lb hike, while Invincible Irish can also have a say.

runners.note: Off 12 weeks (gelded) and proved a different proposition in first-time tongue tie when landing 11-runner maiden over C&D (good) 24 days ago, always holding on. Open to more progress on his handicap debut. Big shout.
Showed ability when eighth in 5f Cork maiden but last of 15 in maiden at Naas (6f, good to firm) 36 days ago. Cheekpieces now go on for handicap debut.

Much improved in first-time cheekpieces with third of 14 to Santo Parvenue in nursery at Naas (5f, good to soft) 11 days ago, though he hung right under pressure. Needs to back it up in retained headgear.
Lightly-raced maiden. 20/1, best effort when fourth of 14 to Santo Parvenue in nursery at Naas (5f, good to soft) 11 days ago. Can make his presence felt off the same mark.

Little show first 3 runs but (gelded) and much improved in first-time blinkers (retained) to bag 14-runner nursery at Naas (5f, good to soft) 11 days ago, always holding on. Hiked up 8 lb but should go well again.
Well held all 3 starts, hooded for the first time when fifth of 8 in maiden at Naas (5f, good to soft) 11 days ago. Makes handicap debut.
Maiden who doesn't look to have much ability, only eighth of 14 to Santo Parvenue in nursery at Naas (5f, good to soft) 11 days ago. Lots more is required.
Lightly-raced maiden. 16/1, tenth of 13 in nursery at Naas (1m, good to soft) 11 days ago. Significantly back down in trip. Looks up against it.

races.name: Matchbook SignUp - Get 20% Back On Losses Handicap
races.verdict: It could be worth siding with HARRY BROWN to bounce back in style off a lenient-looking mark now dropped in grade. Recent Windsor scorer Roman Spring rates the obvious threat ahead of Bated Breeze and Beach Partee.

runners.note: Respectable fourth at Windsor on reappearance in May but hasn't built on that in 3 starts since, well below par both runs for new yard at Yarmouth and Pontefract (tongue tied first time) this summer.
Not scored since last March but has made the frame on several occasions this year. Needs to bounce back from 2 below-par all-weather runs at Kempton and Lingfield, though.
Gained back-to-back 5f all-weather wins this winter but arrives out of sorts, beating only one in handicap at Windsor (5f, good to firm) last time.
Made all in classified event at Leicester (5f) in June. Bounced back to form with second of 11 to Roman Spring in handicap at Windsor (5f, good to firm) 3 weeks ago. Needs to follow that up here.

Scored at Lingfield (5f) in May and caught the eye when third at Epsom (6f) in July. Down the field at Lingfield (well backed, blew the start) and Sandown since but not without interest dropped in grade here off a handy-

Won 3 times as a juvenile (including here). Yet to score as a 3-y-o but arrives on the back of a trio of creditable efforts, latterly when fourth of 12 in handicap at Southwell (5f) 11 days ago. Should remain competitive
Back to front-running tactics when landing 11-runner handicap at Windsor (5f, good to firm) 21 days ago by ¾ length from Dreambird Dolly. Up 3 lb but this course winner must enter calculations.
Sole victory came back in 2024 for Charlie Fellowes. Best effort for this stable when second at Lingfield in March but below form in his 4 subsequent outings. Cheekpieces go on for the first time.

Finally got off the mark in 6f classified event here in July. Posted a good third of 11 to Roman Spring in handicap at Windsor (5f, good to firm) 3 weeks ago. Needs considering in refitted cheekpieces.
Long-standing maiden. Not disgraced when fourth of 7 in Bath handicap (5f, good to firm) in May. Absent since though so needs to hit the ground running.

races.name: Athleague Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: Following a promising hurdling debut, TELEGRAM SAM ought to be capable of winning a race of this nature. Direct Approach could have a big say if headgear has the desired effect, with Henry de Bromhead's Sonas another likely type.

runners.note: Dam half-sister to fairly useful hurdler (stayed 25f) Abbreviate. Only fair form in 1¼m events on the Flat for Jamie Osborne this year. Likely a longer-term project over hurdles for new yard.

Quirky sort who is a fair maiden on Flat. Best effort over hurdles when third in a Kilbeggan maiden in July. Ran up to his best when beaten 5 lengths on the level at Dundalk last time. Could go close reverted to hurdling
Well below his best on the Flat this season. Did show more than on hurdles bow when fifth in big-field Limerick maiden in May. Would need to build on that to trouble the judge back hurdling, though.
Sumbal gelding. Dam unraced. Yard can ready one first time up, but this doesn't look an obvious type on paper.

Attracted support when green/well held in a Leopardstown bumper on debut for Eoin Griffin in March. Offered only a little encouragement on hurdling debut at Kilbeggan latest. Direct Approach looks stable's leading hope.
Borderline fairly useful over 1m at his best on the Flat. Now sent hurdling having failed to fire this season. At least worth a second look in an ordinary event.

Shaped with promise when fourth in Ballinrobe bumper in May. Similar story when 8½-length third on return/hurdling debut at Kilbeggan latest, coming from further back than the pair that beat him. Sets the standard and op
Third sole start in points. Ran too badly to be true when well backed (5/4) in a Wexford bumper for Ian John McCarthy in May. Needs another market check sent hurdling by capable new yard.
Bred to stay well and merely looks to be marking time in maidens before tackling handicaps/longer trips.

Maxios filly. Dam, lightly raced in bumpers/over hurdles, sister to top-class hurdler around 2m Darlan. Wears hood. Makes some appeal on paper and worth noting for each-way support, in what hardly looks a deep maiden.
Well held both starts to date and will be better off in handicaps.

Free Eagle filly. Half-sister to fairly useful hurdler Turndlightsdownlow, stays 25f, and modest hurdler Tommies Call. Dam (c128/h151) 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner, also 1¾m-2½m winner on Flat. Yard has had success with thi

Shaped with more encouragement than in a bumper when beaten 21 lengths on hurdling debut at Wexford (2½m) in late-July, not given anything like a hard time (125/1). Will do better at some stage for Gordon Elliott, probab
Well beaten on completed starts in maiden hurdles. Likely to need time/distance. RESERVE
Related to some above-average jumpers. Tongue strap added and showed more than on debut when 18 lengths second of 12 at Wexford (17f). In the mix if progressing again for excellent yard.

races.name: Clearwater DC Ltd Environmental Solutions Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict: ANNIE EDSON TAYLOR has rediscovered her form over C&D on softer ground and is taken to record the hat-trick. Punchbowl Flyer and Maldevious head up the dangers.

runners.note: Successful at Thirsk in June and put a couple of below-par efforts behind her when resuming winning ways refitted with cheekpieces over C&D twice this month in the mud. Has a 5-lb penalty to shoulder but can go well agai
Gained a deserved breakthrough win at Thirsk in August and was quickly back on track at Newcastle last time. Drops back in grade here.
Surprise 200/1 winner of an Ayr maiden (soft) in June. Back to form when doubling his tally over 5f here (40/1) last month but little impact in 2 starts since. Others more persuasive.
Resumed winning ways at Carlisle in June. Back to form when length second of 13 to Big Apple Jack in C&D handicap 26 days ago. Cheekpieces are retained and now needs to back that last effort up.
Won back-to-back 6f handicaps at Chepstow and Ffos Las in June. Has failed to repeat that in 3 starts since but is already back down to last winning mark and any further rain will help.
Capitalised on a career-low mark to win 7-runner handicap over C&D (soft, 11/4) last week, making all. Carries a 4-lb penalty and doesn't appeal as being the type to follow up on balance.

races.name: Celebrating Devon Women In Business Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A case can be made for each of these previous course winners. DEPALMA has the scope for most improvement, though, and may get the better of the in-form Limerick Leader on this occasion.

runners.note: Narrowly denied in 2 handicap hurdles before scoring readily in a C&D chase on third start for Dan Skelton. Didn't look 100% on final run for the yard last month. Will need to get back on the up to make a winning start f

One of several success stories for his yard this season. Well ridden to defeat Depalma at Bangor prior to defying a penalty at Sedgefield (3¼m). Made a bold bid for hat-trick when ¾-length second at Kelso (2¾m) latest. D

Two-time Irish point winner. Shaped well when 3-length second to Limerick Leader on stable debut at Bangor. Overcame return to hurdles/shorter trip to get off the mark in course novice (2¾m) last time. Makes plenty of ap

races.name: Coors Fillies Handicap
races.verdict: A case can be made for a few but NELLCOTE has improved a chunk with each of her 3 runs and is fancied to quickly resume winning ways after an excellent second on her handicap bow at the Curragh. Stellar Moment is another filly on an upward curve and she can also go well on the back of her own improved handicap showing when runner-up at Roscommon. C&D scorer Navy Waters is weighted to go well too,

runners.note: Useful filly but has twice failed to build on a promising yard debut when well held at Cork and Galway this summer. Cheekpieces go on for first time.
Back on track with seventh of 11 in handicap at the Curragh (1½m, good) 37 days ago. Stable having good spell so not out of things in first-time cheekpieces.
C&D winner. Yet to score this term but in good nick until tenth of 16 in listed race at Galway (1½m, soft) 20 days ago. Weighted to go close back in handicap company for her in-form stable.
Fairly useful mare. Posted a solid fifth in listed race at Galway but well held back in handicap company at Listowel (1½m, good to soft) 7 days ago. Bounce back is needed.

Fairly useful winner for John & Thady Gosden in 2025. Got back on track for her new yard in a first-time hood (retained) with third of 18 in handicap at Fairyhouse (1¾m, good to soft) in June. Considered after a break.

Lightly-raced sort who won at Fairyhouse in July. Has posted solid efforts in a pair of handicaps at the Curragh since, eighth of 11 on latter occasion (1½m, good) last month. Possibilities off a 3 lb lower mark.

Improving Sottsass filly. Landed 1½m maiden at Limerick in July before an excellent second of 11 on handicap debut at the Curragh (1½m, good) last month. That form is working out very well so she's a big player with bett

Consistent sort who is knocking on the door in handicaps, runner-up for the third consecutive start in 11-runner event at Clonmel (17f, good) 12 days ago when left with lot to do. Effective at this shorter trip. Merits c

Progressive Ulysses filly. Off the mark in 16-runner maiden at Galway (1½m) in July and beaten only a head when runner-up in 15-runner handicap at Roscommon (1½m, good to soft) 4 weeks ago. That form is looking good and

Got off the mark for the season at Leopardstown (15f). Possibly found the race coming too soon when fifteenth of 18 in handicap at Galway (1¾m, soft) later in July. Freshened up since and no surprise to see her bounce ba

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not the easiest maiden to assess and it could be worth siding with James Tate's well-related Starman filly GALILEO STAR to make a winning debut, especially if the market vibes are positive. Form pick River Nile could have a big say though if shrugging off a lesser effort at Pontefract, while Poor Relation is not out of things either.

runners.note: 300/1 and green when a well-held sixth of 7 in maiden at Lingfield (1m, all-weather) on his belated debut 32 days ago.

13,000 gns foal, €20,000 yearling, €135,000 2-y-o, Starman colt. Half-brother to several winners, including useful 2-y-o 6f/7f winner Galeron and useful 1¼m-1½m winner Goldenfield. Looks a very interesting newcomer here,
Well-related Without Parole filly who made an encouraging start with third of 5 in novice at Lingfield (1m, all-weather) 25 days ago. She can build on it here.
Fair maiden who wasn't disgraced when seventh of 10 in handicap at Wolverhampton (9.5f) 27 days ago. Down in trip. Not out of things back in maiden company.

Placed in a pair of 7f/1m Kempton novices this summer. Well below that level when fourth of 6 in maiden at Pontefract (1m, good to soft) 11 days ago, though got no cover from her outside draw. The form pick.
Ran green when a remote last of 3 on her debut in novice at Yarmouth (1m, firm) in July. Lots more is required.

races.name: Gary's Gardening Services Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: Preference is for COOL SUMMER, who has seen the form of her success at Wexford boosted by the fifth winning next time. She can continue her progress to score again, though Colesberg is also open to further improvement after his third on handicap debut at Tramore. Another Blunder completes the shortlist.

runners.note: Best effort when runner-up in mares handicap at Naas (2m) in March. Below-par effort next time but got back on track when fourth of 15 at Sligo (2¼m) in May. Needs to pick up where she left off after 4-month break.
Some promise in maidens and took a step forward after 3 months off when third of 14 on handicap debut at Tramore 6 weeks ago. Could be in the mix with better still to come.

Has been going the right way in handicaps this season, opening account in 12-runner contest at Wexford a month ago. Form from last time has been boosted since and she can make a bold bid to follow up.

Fairly useful winner on the Flat when trained in England. Has offered a bit of encouragement in 3 maiden hurdles for present stable, sixth of 14 at Punchestown in January. Absent 8 months since ahead of handicap hurdle d

Proved at least as good as ever when runner-up in mares handicap at Listowel in June. However, she isn't the easiest to catch right and was in the progress of running poorly when falling 2 out here the following month.

Has had 3 starts in maiden hurdles for this yard, showing a bit more than on stable debut when fifth of 11 at Kilbeggan in July. Made no impression at the same course 25 days ago, but she could yet do better now handicap

Finally off the mark in handicap at Limerick (21f) in December. Bounced back from a lesser effort with 2 in-frame efforts this spring, fourth of 16 at Kilbeggan (25f) in April when last seen. Trip might be on the sharp s

Placed twice in mares maidens last season, before seeming stretched by the step up to 2½m when mid-field on handicap debut at Thurles in October. However, after 7 months off she ran poorly back in maiden company at Clonm

Stepped forward from reappearance run when second in 19f handicap at Clonmel in June. Below form both starts since, though, seeming set to drop away when falling 2 out at Downpatrick (2¾m) 7 weeks ago. Drop back in trip
Has yet to offer much over hurdles/on the Flat, always behind running on the level when last of 14 in maiden at this venue (1½m) in June. Back over hurdles after 3 months off.

Fitted with tongue strap, fared better than previously on second handicap start when sixth of 15 at Clonmel in April. He failed to complete after 5 months off, though, jinking and unseating at the fourth at Wexford a mon

Ran well over hurdles when third of 18 in handicap at Punchestown in May, but was let down by his jumping at Kilbeggan in July. Has made the frame back on the Flat last 2 starts, running well when third of 14 at Punchest
Wasn't ideally positioned with cheekpieces on for first time when seventh of 15 at Sligo in May. However, didn't get very far at Bellewstown last month, unseating at the first.

Making only her second handicap start, showed her first form under a more positive ride when 5 lengths fourth of 12 to Cool Summer at Wexford a month ago. Merits consideration on the back of her latest run.

Maiden who failed to fire last season following a lengthy absence (over fences first 2 starts). Tried in hood (now discarded) after another 3 months off, was pulled up in handicap hurdle at Bellewstown when last seen in

Still looking for a breakthrough success but ran well when making the frame at Wexford in July/August. However, back in cheekpieces she ran one of lesser races when tenth of 15 at Bellewstown last time.
Long-standing maiden who hasn't made much impact back over hurdles last 2 starts for current yard, eleventh of 20 in handicap at Galway 3 weeks ago. RESERVE.
After 7 months off ahead of first run since leaving Patrick Downey, showed improved form sent handicapping when fourth of 20 at Galway 3 weeks ago. In good hands to progress further. RESERVE.
Hasn't managed to find any improvement switched to handicaps this season, finishing twelfth of 20 at Galway on latest outing. RESERVE.

races.name: Moira Stein Memorial EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CYBERSPACE is likely to step up again after his second at Redcar and this looks a good opportunity. Youngheartsrunfree is the other potential improver in the field so is second choice.

runners.note: Bred to be sharp and stepped up on debut when second in Redcar novice 2 weeks ago, giving the impression he's still learning. Looks the one to beat with more still to come.
Showed a bit more when fourth of 13 in Beverley maiden 12 days ago, faring best of the trio who forced the pace. Entitled to come on again and he has only a little to find.
Looking exposed already but a reproduction of his latest fourth in nursery at Carlisle puts him bang there in this company.

€15,000 yearling, Soldier's Call colt. Half-brother to 2 winners, including 5f winner Fortunate Star. Dam winner up to 6f (2-y-o 5f winner). Looked badly in need of the experience when fifth of 13 in Beverley maiden 12 d
Found to be amiss on debut and showed ability when fifth of 7 in a Wolverhampton novice (5f). However, well held at Beverley 9 days later.
€4,000 foal, £12,000 2-y-o, Space Traveller filly. Dam 6f winner. Never a threat in Beverley novice.

races.name: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MATIWO stands out on form and is fancied to make a winning return at the expense of Ride Like A Girl and Scott's Legacy.

runners.note: Modest 1¼m winner on the Flat. Ran to a similar level both starts over hurdles, latterly beaten 15¼ lengths in a first-time hood over C&D. Will be better off in handicaps after this run.

Head-strong sort. Has stood little racing since his useful days on the Flat in 2024. Bombed out twice for Willie Mullins (including on hurdle debut in the Triumph) last year and was well beaten in first-time tongue strap

Fair bumper winner. Seemingly all the better for a breathing operation when opening her hurdles account in a mares handicap at Huntingdon in May. Hasn't advanced her form with seconds in novices at Uttoxeter/Bangor since

Newbury juvenile hurdle winner who stands out on his fourth in the Grade 2 Dovecote at Kempton in February. Let down by his jumping at Compiegne subsequently but has his sights firmly lowered for this return to action. T

Showed a bit when hitting the frame in a course bumper in July. Looks to be being brought along with handicaps in mind over hurdles, finishing down the field in first-time hood at Worcester (2m, 100/1) last time.

No shortage of stamina on his dam's side. Found plenty/showed a good attitude when making his second bumper start a winning one at Southwell in March (third since won a maiden). Returns with yard in good form, though lik

Cheap purchase who has looked a tricky ride when placing in Fontwell bumpers 4 months apart. Something to find on her bumper form and probably the type who'll need the experience of her hurdling debut.

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: STAR GLORY bounced back to form when second at Naas last month and can give Noel Meade a third win in 5 runnings in this fillies maiden. Ladrona is an appealing newcomer, while Essence of Time and Hip Hop Chrissy could have races in them.

runners.note: Has shown plenty to work on in maidens, well backed and not seen to best effect from the worst of the draw at Bellewstown (5f) in July then chasing home a classier pair at Dundalk (6f) 6 weeks ago. Upped further in trip

€42,000 yearling, State of Rest filly. Half-sister to 2-y-o 6f winner Karaoke. Dam, US 6.5f winner, half-sister to smart winner up to 1m (Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf) Hootenanny. Supported but proved too green in 7f Gowr
Foaled April 19. Cracksman filly. Half-sister to 3 winners, including useful 1m-1¼m winner Regal Charm and useful 1m-1¼m winner who became ungenuine High Spirited. Of obvious interest on debut.
Foaled April 6. €36,000 yearling, Kodi Bear filly. Half-sister to several winners, including winner up to 1¼m Ellexis and 2-y-o 6f winner Aurag.

Proved her Galway running all wrong back on a more conventional course when second of 16 in 7f Naas maiden last month, playing her hand after the winner and third had engaged each other for around 1f. Big shout for stabl

Foaled April 1. Saxon Warrior filly. Half-sister to 9f winner Givemehoperosa and Italian 1m winner Cult Figure. Dam, 1m-9.4f winner, half-sister to useful 2-y-o 6f/7f winner Bible Black. Stable 0-21 with 2-y-o newcomers

€24,000 yearling, €50,000 2-y-o, Starman filly. Dam, winner up to 9f (2-y-o 7f winner) in Britain/France. Not unbacked but shaped as if in need of the experience when eighth in 21-runner 6f Naas maiden 11 days ago. Step

Foaled May 5. €10,000 yearling, Nando Parrado filly. Closely related to 2-y-o 1m winner Iamimmaculate, and half-sister to 3 winners, including useful 2-y-o 7.4f winner in Italy Azul Bahia. Engaged 1.25 Curragh Sunday.
Improved from debut when 2¾ lengths second of 14 in C&D maiden 3 weeks ago and should give another good showing.

5,000 gns yearling, Dark Angel filly. Half-sister to winner up to 1½m Tremorgio and 2-y-o 7f winner Miss Honey. Dam, 2-y-o 7f winner, half-sister to smart winner up to 1m Duneflower. 80/1 but offered something to work on

races.name: Follow Matchbook On X Nursery
races.verdict: Not as competitive as the numbers suggest. MAGICAL LIFE rates just the pick of the weights and is taken to double her tally at the chief expense of Wild Orchid who comes here on the back of an improved Yarmouth fourth on her nursery debut. Beach Ahead and Allaboutthelunch can also have a say.

runners.note: Got off the mark in 7f maiden at Chepstow in July. Unseated rider early on nursery debut at Newbury after and failed to beat a rival in 1m Kempton nursery 23 days ago.
Modest form when fourth in novices at Nottingham (6f) and Newmarket (1m) in August. Suffered a poor run when seventh of 8 in nursery at Yarmouth (7f, good) 13 days ago. Remains likely to do better.
Never a threat on all 3 runs, eighth of 10 in novice at Windsor (1m, good to firm) 35 days ago. Needs this switch to handicaps to spark major progress.
Lightly-raced maiden. Tongue strap on for first time when a good third of 9 in seller at Salisbury (7f, soft) 17 days ago. Respected now going into handicaps.
Lightly-raced maiden. Gelded before coming in ninth of 14 on nursery debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 3 weeks ago. Blinkers go on for first time.
Well held on all her 3 starts, sixth of 7 in 5f novice at Wolverhampton in July. Takes a big step up in trip for her handicap debut.
Failed to build on a promising nursery sixth at Kempton (6f) when occupying same position in 7f nursery there later in August. Worth another chance now tried with a visor.
Gained a first success in 1m Kempton nursery in August. Not disgraced with sixth of 11 in nursery at Bath (1m, good) 15 days ago. Can go well eased 1 lb.
Yet to offer much in her 3 outings, ninth of 10 in maiden at Newbury (6f, firm) last time. Goes up in distance for her first go in handicaps.

Best effort when fourth of 14 on nursery debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) but failed to back it up under much softer conditions when just fifth of 9 in seller at Salisbury (7f) 17 days ago. Bounce back is required.
Took a big step forward on her nursery bow with fourth of 10 at Yarmouth (1m, good) 11 days ago. Can make her presence felt off the same mark.
Only poor form but he wasn't discredited in first-time cheekpieces when fifth of 10 in nursery at Yarmouth (1m, good) 11 days ago. No forlorn hope.
Showed more than previously when second of 11 in nursery at Bath (1m, good) 15 days ago. Merits consideration bidding for a first success at the seventh attempt.

races.name: Kelly Hearing Specialists Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: KIMI DE MAI looks the most likely winner, while acknowledging that she has been expensive to follow in similar events. Wicked Pleasure appeals as the main danger, with fellow hurdling debutants Born Believing and Culldoo also respected. Brave Lady is the pick of the remainder with hurdles experience.

runners.note: Point winner (1-1) who belied market weakness to follow up in a bumper at Cork (2m). Subsequently found emphasis on speed against her when well-held fifth in Grade 3 bumper at Punchestown. Should appreciate switch to lon

Fair bumper winner. Ran to a similar level without success in mares maiden hurdles last season. Hasn't improved for the switch to handicaps/longer trips more recently. Something to find at the weights back down in distan

Ex-French bumper winner. Standout effort over hurdles when third in listed handicap hurdle at Leopardstown in early-February (heavy). Turned over at short odds 4 times in maidens either side of that, though may have held

Bright start over hurdles when runner-up at Kilbeggan (2m) in July. Built on that returning to calmer waters at Ballinrobe (2¼m) last time, finishing 4½ lengths second in mares maiden. Bred to stay this longer trip and s
Went with no promise when pulled up in novice hurdle (150/1) at Ballinrobe (2¾m, good) on debut.
Stoutly-bred mare. Placed 3 times in points prior to finishing well-held sixth of 13 on hurdling debut at Kilbeggan (2m, 50/1). Probably one for handicaps, for all this longer trip ought to suit.

Placed twice from 4 starts in points. Never looked like justifying support on Rules debut. Sent off at much bigger price in first-time hood at Galway (17f) subsequently, finishing a promising sixth with a view to handica
Showed a bit in bumpers at the start of the summer. Up in trip having made no impact at long odds in 2 hurdles. Another one for handicaps.
Improved on her hurdling debut form when 7¾-length third in a Ballinrobe maiden (2¾m) last time. Needs more again in a stronger race here.

Well-related daughter of Harzand. Shaped with promise in a couple of bumpers on testing ground at Thurles/Gowran last winter. That form has substance and she may well improve on hurdling debut given her pedigree/connecti
Tongue strap fitted, she went backwards from her debut when down the field in a Galway Festival bumper. Probably one for the longer term now switched to hurdles.

Hinted at temperament when hitting the frame in a couple of bumpers over the summer. Badly hampered/didn't have a cut at her flights when mid-field at Downpatrick (2¼m) on hurdles bow latest, finishing with running left.

Ran to a similar level to place in Downpatrick bumpers 3 months apart. Respected stepping up trip with tongue strap added on hurdling debut, for all Kimi De Mai appears to be her excellent yard's leading hope.
Maiden staying handicapper at a modest level on the Flat. Hardly appeals as an obvious type switched to hurdling.

Showed a bit on the third of her 2m juvenile starts. Didn't benefit from the longer trip as expected when down the field at Tramore (2¾m) in late-May, perhaps all not well considering her subsequent absence.
Little appeal on paper and shaped accordingly at Kilbeggan (19f, 100/1) on debut in May.
Cheap purchase. Pulled up in a point prior to offering little on debut for top yard at Kilbeggan (19f). Cheekpieces now reached for. RESERVE
Regressed in bumpers following her debut fourth at Leopardstown (shaped like a stayer). Step back up in trip can only benefit now sent hurdling by in-form yard. RESERVE
Third on her sole start in points in May. Well held on hurdling debut at Ballinrobe and likely to need more time. RESERVE

races.name: Rotary Club East Kilbride Nursery Selling Handicap
races.verdict: FERN CLYDE is the only previous winner in the field and can double her tally at the expense of Or Another, who should appreciate the drop back in trip.

runners.note: Got back on track when making the frame at Carlisle on stable debut but went the wrong way upped to 1m at Thirsk last time. The return to sprinting should suit.

Improved to get off the mark in an ordinary maiden at Pontefract (6f) in June. Laboured effort when fifth of 7 in seller at Redcar (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago. The most exposed but expected to be bang there.

Lightly-raced maiden who's shown only poor form to date but did shape a bit better than result despite finishing no better than mid-field on nursery debut at Thirsk 2 weeks ago. Now needs to build on that.
Is yet to offer much in 4 starts and is hard to recommend. The tongue tie is quickly discarded again.
Matched debut form when fourth of 7 in nursery (12/1) at Musselburgh (1m, good to firm) last month. Now reverts to sprinting.
Has made little impact so far and is hard to make a case for.
Cut little ice first 3 starts and may do better now sent handicapping.

races.name: Shelley Coles - Setting the Pace at 60 Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The switch to fences may see an improved effort from lightly-raced MINELLA JURY, who showed plenty of promise in the early part of last season and returns with his yard bang in form. A compelling case can be made for each of the others, with Juggernaut perhaps the most likely danger following a comfortable success over C&D last time.

runners.note: Thriving when completing a 4-timer (and C&D hat-trick) in another small-field event last month. Clearly didn't give his running off a 5-day turnaround here subsequently. Has been given time to get over that and may go cl

Fairly useful bumper winner in Ireland. Looked set to make it 2 from 3 over hurdles when exiting on handicap bow at Doncaster in February and didn't look over that fall at Plumpton 5 weeks later. Low-mileage 6-y-o is int

Fairly useful type who notched his fourth career hurdles win in smooth style on return here (2m) last year. Presumably had a few issues subsequently but looked on his way back when beaten 9 lengths at Chepstow in April.

Back to his best in first-time blinkers when landing 5-runner C&D chase with extra to spare earlier this month. Could well follow up despite being just out of the weights, with promising 5-lb claimer again in the saddle

races.name: Madri Excepcional Maiden
races.verdict: DARING HEART has been seen just twice in 13 months but clearly has stacks of ability and could be the one to beat if taking another step forward in a first-time tongue tie. Keogie and Aidan O'Brien's Monmouth are dangers.

runners.note: Well beaten in maidens.

Related to a couple of useful winners and having shaped well in a deep 7f Curragh maiden on debut in August 2025, continued his promising start when second, beaten just ½ length, in 15-runner 1m Leopardstown contest in M
Has had plenty of chances, not running so well at Listowel last week, but big chance on his previous close call at Gowran over this trip.
Showed a bit when seventh of 16 in maiden at Limerick (7f, soft) on debut in June.

Left previous efforts behind fitted with cheekpieces after 11 weeks off having had the run of things when third in 7f Limerick maiden in June, splitting subsequent winners. Bred to do much better and one to note tried wi
Little sign of ability in 3 runs at the end of last year.
No form in Flat maiden/2 juvenille maiden hurdles.

€850,000 Blue Point filly. Closely related to smart 8.3f-10.2f winner Botanical and half-sister to very smart winner up to 1½m Bay City Roller. Well backed having won a barrier trial and shaped well enough when held in t
€1,200 Coulsty filly. Half-sister to winner John Paul Jones and 1m winner Katie's Kitten. Dam 1m winner. 200/1, tongue tied and little encouragement in 7f Fairyhouse maiden on debut last week.
Sent off 125/1 but took another step forward when 1½ lengths second of 17 in 7f Fairyhouse maiden last week, racing freely but keeping on. Not out of this if improving again.

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 40 Pound In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict: NEWFANGLED rates just the pick of the weights and captured this prize 12 months ago so edges the vote from hat-trick seeking Danehill Star. Hamda's Joy and Gone Rogue also need factoring into this wide-open handicap.

runners.note: Temperamental sort but he doubled his tally for the season at Epsom (8.5f) in September. Not at his best under a penalty when seventh of 12 in handicap at Windsor (1m, good) 14 days ago. Bounce back is needed.

Took this contest in 2025. Also scored at Wolverhampton (9.5f) in April and right back on track of late when in the frame in 1m handicaps at Wolverhampton again and at Windsor. Can go very well off an unchanged mark.

Front runner who enjoyed an excellent spell this summer, winning 5 times with 3 of those victories coming here. Rare below-par effort when fourth of 6 in handicap here (7f, good) 27 days ago but no surprise to see him bo

Multiple all-weather winner. Showed a good attitude when opening his turf account at the fifteenth time of asking over C&D and followed up in 10-runner handicap at Bath (1m, good to soft) 15 days ago. Hiked up 8 lb but n
Bagged a pair of 7f/1m all-weather handicaps in the spring. Below that form since though, going too freely at Salisbury and Doncaster on last 2 occasions. Drops back in trip now.
Gained a third victory here over C&D in August. Left poorly placed when sixth of 7 in handicap at Goodwood (9f, good) last time so not out of things.
Gained a first win in 1m Ripon maiden in July. Unable to dominate stronger opposition on handicap bow at Doncaster (1¼m) since and more is required here.
In the frame again and advanced her form when second of 6 in handicap at Wolverhampton (8.6f) 27 days ago. Very much one to consider off the same mark.
C&D winner. Yet to score this term but in good form until only fifth of 7 in handicap at Salisbury (1m, good to soft) last month. Needs to get back on track.
Won twice over 7f at Wolverhampton in the spring for Ivan Furtado. However, he hasn't fired since then, including both runs for his new stable on all-weather at Lingfield and Kempton.

races.name: Railway Bar Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: A mightily difficult puzzle with several potentially ahead of their marks. DUCE BIGALOW gets the nod in his bid to make it 2-2 for his present yard. Bruise Hill and Ardgillan are both feared, especially as the pace has the potential to be strong. Ancient Myth completes the shortlist.

runners.note: Off the mark on the Flat this summer. Going the right way over hurdles now, travelled well when pipped in a similar event at Navan (19f) last time. Should go well again off 3 lb higher.
Hasn't come close to adding to his sole success in recent starts, finishing down the field in first-time cheekpieces at Roscommon (3m) latest.

Successful on second of 2 starts in points. Runner-up in pair of maiden hurdles this summer, latterly beaten 17 lengths off a quick turnaround at Kilbeggan (25f). Back down in trip for handicap bow and his opening mark d

Off the mark on reappearance at Downpatrick in March before improving to finish second at Limerick (had subsequent winners behind on both occasions). Hasn't fired in 3 starts this season, easy to back at Ballinrobe (2m)
Low-mileage 5-y-o. Hit the frame in a Naas maiden/Gowran handicap last season. In good hands and weighted to go well on his return.

Trailblazer who was successful over hurdles off only 1 lb higher at Galway (soft) last autumn. Hasn't been in much form over fences of late, though, a spent force by 2 out when well-held seventh of 16 in handicap chase a

Ridden more positively in first-time blinkers when beaten 6 lengths at Ballinrobe (2¾m) latest, possibly finding his stamina stretched. Back down in trip for only his third handicap start and still on a potentially handy

Knocking firmly at the door over fences for Seamus Neville last winter. Easily made a winning start for current yard in handicap hurdle at Down Royal (3m) in April, doing it in good style from the front. Drop back in tri
Off over 2 years since his much-improved second on handicap bow at Listowel (2¾m, soft). Entitled to need this.

Didn't show much when last seen under Rules for Patrick G. Kelly in December 2024. Won a point in February of this year and market can guide returning to Rules off much-reduced mark for new connections.

Hold-up type. Proved a different proposition in first-time hood/tongue strap when finding plenty to land a 16-runner handicap hurdle at Bellewstown (2½m) latest. Still interesting off 5 lb higher, especially if strong pa
Lightly-raced 5-y-o. Improved back in calmer waters when beaten only by a well-backed favourite at Wexford (2½m) last time. Makes plenty of appeal in a race that should again be run to suit.

Found improvement to open his account on return to handicap/longer trip at Sligo last time (21f), all out to hold on. That form has some substance but will need more again to follow up off his revised mark.
Maiden who placed off higher marks than this last season. Hasn't fired this season, the first-time hood he wore over fences last time quickly discarded. Not discounted if back on song.

Hit-and-miss maiden who made the frame in 2 handicaps for J. D. Motherway last season. Shaped as if in need of the run on stable debut at Clonmel in May. On a reasonable mark if ready to roll with Daniel King taking over
Turned in his best effort for nearly 2 years when 7¼ lengths behind Move It On Over at Sligo (21f), despite taking a strong hold. Will need to build on that to double his tally (1-39 under Rules).

Successful on the second of 2 starts in points. Looked to be being brought along steadily in maidens in 2023. Showed a bit when beaten 7¾ lengths on belated return/handicap bow at Ballinrobe (2¾m). Remains to be seen if

Low-mileage 7-y-o. Showed up fairly well before absence seemed to tell on reappearance last month. Tighter in the betting with tongue strap refitted but went backwards from that effort at Ballinrobe 2 weeks on. Headgear

Shaped with some encouragement at long odds in maidens. Saw out his race with more purpose with hood added at Ballinrobe last time, finishing 5½ lengths sixth of 16 (2¾m, 66/1). Still very early days in handicaps and wor

races.name: John MacKenzie And Hamish MacGregor Memorial Handicap
races.verdict: LIR SPECIALE has been running well all summer so this could be his day with conditions now in his favour. This does look very competitive, though, with penalised-winner Good Morning Alex and class-dropper El Matador heading the dangers.

runners.note: Won a pair of novice events last spring and good placed efforts in handicaps this season. Ground shouldn't be a problem and needs considering back down in class.
Progressed into a useful handicapper last season but has struggled this campaign. Visor tried (little impact when wearing cheekpieces previously).
Strong-travelling type who ran another solid race when third at Ayr 11 days ago. Drop back in trip should suit if anything and he's one for the shortlist.
Won twice at up to 9f for Dermot Weld in Ireland last year. Mixed record for current handler this season but drop back in trip should at least suit.
Took form to another level when winning here (9f, good to firm) last month. Pulled too hard upped in trip since. Winner on good to soft, unraced on softer.

Won the Golden Mile at Glorious Goodwood last season. Has failed to reach those heights since but made much more of an impact off reduced mark last 2 starts, though was no match for the winner at Haydock.

Winner on soft ground at Carlisle last summer and returned to his best in first-time headgear (cheekpieces) when runner-up at Chester 16 days ago. Up 2 lb but he remains below his winning mark. Visor now tried.
Ended 2025 with back-to-back wins in the mud at Doncaster. Some decent efforts in defeat this season and conditions have now come in his favour. Could be the answer.
As good as ever when a narrow winner at Ripon (1m) in April. Mixed record since but he handles the mud so not out of things from an easing mark.
Took advantage of drop in grade when winning at Pontefract on return in May. However, she added to her patchy record at York 4 months later.
Yet to win a handicap but he went very close in a small field at Ripon in July. However, struggled in big fields at York since.
Confirmed previous promise when recording an eighth career success over C&D (soft) last week, holding on gamely. Can go well again under a penalty now back on track.
Consistent filly who didn't have to improve when a narrow winner at Ayr (soft) 11 days ago. Not an obvious type to follow up off 2 lb higher in better race.

races.name: Final Furlong Before 'I Do' Selling Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: The Twiston-Davies team have had a few horses win on reappearance in recent days and LIGHTNING FLASH could well be another. Berry Edge is feared most on second start for Dan Skelton.

runners.note: Successful over C&D in June prior to completing a handicap hurdle hat-trick with little to spare at Sedgefield last month. Looked a difficult ride when beaten 16½ lengths on second chase start here latest, which tempers

Successful on latest hurdle start at Perth (2½m) this time last year. Subsequently won on chasing debut (off this mark) before completely losing his confidence over fences. Interesting reverted to hurdles on return, for

Veteran who capitalised on a much-reduced mark when making it 2-2 over C&D in June, beating a next-time-out winner in the process. This is probably a better race, despite the fact it's a selling handicap, and he arrives

Fair 3-time Flat winner. Decisively opened his hurdle account at Wetherby (2m, soft) in February. Matched that form on return (had a breathing operation in the interim) when 2½-length second at Worcester. Solid claims to
Modest place form in bumpers. Only showed a bit on what was effectively her hurdling debut over C&D in June (hasn't bettered that form in 2 starts since). Improvement needed to defy her opening mark.

Course regular who backed up his breakthrough success here (2¼m) with a handful of creditable placed efforts over the summer. Back on his winning mark following a below-par run over C&D last time and cannot be discounted

races.name: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
races.verdict: UNA MATATA is well handicapped if building on a more encouraging run at Dundalk and is worth chancing. 2024-winner Alex Belardo can go well returning to Down Royal and looks a player, while Send Harry is another to consider having bounced back to form when second in front of the selection at Dundalk.

runners.note: Supported and wasted no time getting back to form when going close at Dundalk 10 days ago (bidding to win race for second year running). Good chance if in the same mood back up 4 lb.

Successful twice in handicaps this season, bouncing back to form when scoring at the Galway Festival (7f). One of his better efforts again when fourth at Listowel last week, albeit better placed than most.
Coming up to 3 years without a win (got a double up in October 2023) but should have come on for her Cork run back from 13 weeks off and usually contests better races than this.
Registered a third claiming success of the summer at Gowran (1m) in August. Fair run in a Musselburgh handicap last time, proving typically headstrong. Work to do back down in trip.

Made a winning handicap debut at Dundalk (7f) in January and a good second in claimer there in March. Plenty to prove now after heavy defeats last 3 starts, including back from 4 months off at Dundalk recently.
Has failed to go on from a very good reappearance third at Naas, finishing down the field again back from 3 months off at Fairyhouse a week ago.
Still a maiden and proving hard to catch right, eased off at Cork last time. Player on his near-miss at Limerick in June and now sports a first-time tongue tie with blinkers back on.
Bagged 3 wins at Dundalk over this trip between January and March and took a step back in the right direction behind Send Harry there 10 days ago. Well treated if building on that.
Took this in 2024 and back to winning ways in C&D handicap in June. Not so good in 2 runs since 10 weeks apart but no surprise to see a better showing back at Down Royal.
Still a maiden after 16 runs but plenty of good efforts this year and probably remains in form.

Took a step back in the right direction without looking suited by the drop back in trip in 5f maiden here earlier this month but proved disappointing in claiming maiden at Dundalk on Friday. Returns to 7f now.
Career best when winning 16-runner handicap at Naas (7f) last month but pestered for the lead and was brushed aside at Leopardstown next time. Worth another chance.
Career-best effort when winning over 7f at Fairyhouse in May switched to front-running tactics. Respectable efforts the last twice and has been given some help from the handicapper.
Bits of promise in 1m maidens and could do better now handicapping.

Ended long losing run at Dundalk last October. Turned in his best effort of this season when third of 8 at Naas (7f) 10 weeks ago, collared only late on. Could be set to capitalise on his reduced mark in the coming weeks
Showed a bit in 6f maidens last year but well held in Curragh maiden/Leopardstown handicap earlier this season and needs to show more back from another absence. RESERVE.

races.name: Matchbook Monthly Bet-Builder Rebate Handicap
races.verdict: None of these can be ruled out but the vote goes to DARKEST RED who arrives on the back of a very good Epsom second and can go well again nudged up 2 lb. Miss Guinevere rates a big threat though now she steps up to this trip for the first time, while last year's victor Love You Back also commands plenty of respect.

runners.note: Gained a first win at the twelfth attempt at Ffos Las (1½m) in June. Reportedly struck into when last of 5 in handicap there (1½m, good to soft) last month. Not ruled out.
Resumed winning ways over C&D in May and backed it up with a solid fourth at Goodwood following month. Off 9 weeks, below-par eighth of 12 in handicap at Southwell (1½m) only run since.

Deservedly got off the mark in this event in 2025. Twice runner-up over hurdles since but off since pulled up in handicap hurdle at Sandown (2m) in April. Freshened up since, and no surprise to see him bounce back.
Dual 1¼m winner here in June and has performed with credit when in the frame here on both runs since, third of 7 in handicap (1¼m, good to firm) on latter occasion.
A 2-time scorer in 2025, including over C&D. Made a solid return from 7 months off with fifth of 8 in handicap at Lingfield (1½m, all-weather) in April. Back from another break here.

Fair maiden who has run well since switched to handicap company, staying on when third of 10 at Salisbury (1¼m, soft) 17 days ago. That form has been franked and this longer trip promises to suit this Camelot filly so sh

Yet to register a victory but he's proving reliable and comes here on the back of a very good second of 14 in handicap at Epsom (1½m, good) 18 days ago, doing best of those held up. Weighted to go close.

races.name: Castlecoote Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SMALLCRAFTWARNING did well to finish in the frame having come from further back than the other principals at Listowel last week and now racing back from his 'proper mark' John Ryan's 9-y-o gets the verdict to regain the winning thread. Watching The Clock heads up the dangers having gone close at Wexford back in the spring, with West Is Awake and Roc My Haarth another couple worth considering, too.

runners.note: Completed a remarkable hat-trick at 2023 Galway Festival for Mark Fahey. Had his issues since but shaped encouragingly when third in first-time cheekpieces at Ballinrobe (2¾m) in late-May. Shaped as if needing run at Kil

Made the frame over fences at Kilbeggan for the third race in a row in July but tailed off back over timber at Galway the last twice, facing a stiff task on latest. Tongue tie reapplied for this return to a handicap.

Back on track when winning extended 25f handicap at Kilbeggan in July and made the frame on his next couple of starts. Found his run of good form coming to a halt at same track earlier in the month and now reverts to hur

On long losing run but knocking at the door earlier in the year, finishing runner-up in a big-field handicap for a second successive start at Cork (3m, good to soft) back in April. One to consider having gone well fresh
Failed to show much spark in any of his 3 appearances last season. Best watched back from 8 months off.

Made second handicap start a winning one at Gowran (2m) last October and ran best race after 3 months off when second of 13 at Wexford (3m, good to soft) back in May. Nudged up 3 lb but every chance she will be in the sh

Yet to score over hurdles but has been placed numerous times. Looked laboured when fifth of 18 in handicap at Fairyhouse (1¾m, good to soft) back in June and now hiked up in trip for his return to hurdling.

Dual handicap hurdle winner last season who took her form up a notch in first-time blinkers when 5¾ lengths fourth of 18 at Galway in early-August. Backed that up when filling the same position at Kilbeggan since so one

Both career victories have come at Sligo, showing benefit of his reappearance when landing 16-runner event in June. Ran to a career high despite the race not being run to suit when 3 lengths third of 13 to Smallcraftwarn
Not scored since 2023 and not much encouragement to glean from both recent hurdling efforts (latest in reapplied cheekpieces). Others more appealing.

Got back to winning ways reverted to hurdling in 13-runner event at Kilbeggan (25f) earlier this month and placed both outings since, most recently from 5 lb out of the weights when fourth of 14 at Listowel (3m, good to
Seemingly retains little ability and others preferred. First-time tongue tie applied.

Maiden over hurdles but made it first time lucky over fences in 14-runner handicap at Clonmel (23f, soft) in April. Back hurdling and shaped as if better for the run faced with an inadequate test after 5 months off at Ga

races.name: Barbara Ann Letham And Son Johnathan Memorial Handicap
races.verdict: CITY CAPTAIN took his form to another level when narrowly failing to land a gamble here last week so looks the one to beat off the same mark. Francisco's Piece is next best after his eye-catching run in the Ayr Bronze Cup, while Topwarrior offered a bit more in this headgear at Doncaster last time and is back on a winning mark.

runners.note: Stepped up on his form in Italy when winning off 4 lb higher at Southwell on return in March. However, ran poorly on final start for Marco Botti and showed little encouragement starting out for this yard at Ascot.
Veteran course specialist who recorded his tenth win here over C&D (soft) last week. Must be respected under a penalty.

Goes well in the mud, as shown when winning off this mark at Newbury in a big field last autumn. Yet to fire this season but latest run at Doncaster (in this headgear) was much more encouraging. Interesting.

Took advantage of his reduced mark when ending the drought at Musselburgh in July. Found to have bled after but showed no ill effects in 2 starts since, likely to have been right in the mix had he not met trouble in the

Won 4 times last season and further progress this year, resuming winning ways here (6f) last month. Only just denied the follow up over same C&D last week so obvious claims off the same mark with the drop to 5f unlikely
Back to winning ways at Pontefract in May. Some decent efforts in defeat since but found this level a bit too competitive at Doncaster 2 weeks ago.
Mixed record since winning at Wolverhampton on return but she proved herself on testing ground when a length behind Copper Knight at Chester 9 days ago.

Capitalised on reduced mark when opening her account for the season here (6f) in August. Good in-frame efforts next 3 starts, including at Haydock (heavy) on Saturday, but form suggests she's better at 6f.
Resumed with success over C&D in June. Runner-up on next 2 starts but not in the same form since. Back on last winning mark now at least.
Admirable veteran who took advantage of his low draw and career-low mark when justifying support at Chester 9 days ago. Will likely find this tougher.

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Unexposed KILNEW SUPREME ought to get off the mark if ready to roll. Kom Tu Voudras could be the one to follow him home.

runners.note: Forward-going mare who has won 3 of 7 completed starts for current yard. Things have unfolded favourably for both handicap wins, though she ran as well as ever when 2½-length second to Skelton-trained improver over C&D l

Expensive purchase following second in a point. Filled the same position in a bumper/couple of hurdles last season, doing plenty right under a typically positive ride when 3 lengths behind a fairly useful one at Taunton

Has already won a couple of small-field course handicaps here this season. No match for a Skelton one on a roll when unsuited by drop back in trip here (17f) last time. This test should be much more his bag, though again

Low-mileage 5-y-o (has bled) who won a weak mares maiden at Huntingdon in March. Has proved consistent rather than progressive in handicaps over the summer, going with more zest when 2¼-length second on first try over th

races.name: Pravha Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict: CHLOE'S BOY has few miles on the clock and can follow up from last time. No More Hiding and Tassarolo look the main dangers in this low-grade handicap.

runners.note: Twelve runs since last win in 2025. Had been given some help by the handicapper and again shaped quite well when fourth of 12 in handicap at this course (13f, good) 24 days ago. Can go well again.
Improved upped in trip when second of 13 in handicap at this course (13f, good, 7/2) 24 days ago. Shortlist material.
Hit the frame twice in low-grade handicaps this season, latest when third at Gowran last month, and probably remains in form, mid-field again at Dundalk on Friday.
Lightly-raced 3-y-o who got off the mark in similar company at Punchestown (9f) 13 days ago. Goes back up in trip and could yet still have a bit more to offer.
Showed modest form on debut but failed to back that up both starts since. Significantly up in trip on handicap debut and easy to look elsewhere.
Winner at Dundalk in January and has been in good heart of late from this much lower turf mark. One to note in the betting.
Lightly-raced maiden. Eighth of 14 in handicap (10/1) at Dundalk (10.7f) 10 days ago. Needs to find improvement in first-time cheekpieces.
Down the field in a trio of maidens but improved for the longer trip when third on handicap debut at Sligo last month. Failed to repeat that after racing freely at Roscommon last time.
Lightly-raced maiden. 40/1, got closer than previously when sixth of 16 in handicap at Navan (1m, good) 26 days ago. Significantly back up in trip with a hood added now.
40/1, failed to improve when 4½ lengths ninth of 14 to Chloe's Boy in handicap at Punchestown (9f, good) 13 days ago. Needs more up in trip.
Little impact in varied events. Hayes takes the ride but she's hard to make a case for.
Scored at Dundalk in January but has struggled on turf more recently. Goes back up in trip.
Won at Bellewstown last autumn but hasn't fired this season.
Winless since 2023 and little sign from his recent efforts that is about to change.

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict: BALOO'S BLUES has had a solid campaign and is taken to go one better than over C&D a fortnight ago. Little She went close to a breakthrough success at Lingfield 4 weeks ago and is second choice ahead of Star Start, who was well held last time but has a good overall record under today's rider Charli Parker.

runners.note: Narrow winner over C&D for Kevin Philippart de Foy last summer but just the 1 creditable effort in 4 outings for other yards since. Cut some slack by the handicapper as a result but could only consider if backed.
Got off the mark in 5-runner event at Lingfield (turf) in June. Even better form when second of 12 over C&D 13 days ago. Considered.

Three all-weather wins earlier in the year, including here. More miss than hit since but is starting to look well handicapped again. The first-time visor worn last time is quickly discarded in favour of regular cheekpiec
Two all-weather wins for Hugo Palmer last summer. Proved he retains ability when second in first-time blinkers at Wetherby but not in same form since. A first-time visor replaces the blinkers now.
Proved consistent in similar events this summer, scoring at Pontefract and Haydock under Charli Parker. Rare below par effort at Newmarket 9 days ago but he's not the type to stay down for long.

Has won 11 times at this course, including back-to-back successes over 7f here at the start of 2026. Ran poorly back from a break here last week, though, and needs to have come on a lot in a short time.
C&D winner. Not seen to best effect (forced wide) over C&D last time and this normally consistent performer is likely to bounce back soon.

Returned to form from out of the blue when runner-up at Brighton (7f) last month. Well held on next 2 outings and not at her best when 5 lengths second at Epsom (8.5f) last time (final start for Malcolm Saunders).
C&D winner looks to have lost her way.
Long-standing maiden but turned in her best effort of the current campaign when close second at Lingfield (1¼m, all-weather) in this new headgear combination 27 days ago.
Gained a first success since 2023 in 6-runner handicap at Brighton (1½m) under Ruby Criscuolo last month. Rare below-par run at Southwell last time and likely to bounce back.

races.name: Play Your Multiples At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict: Lots with chances but ROYAL COUNTY GLORY has looked a different model since joining Jack Jones and is fancied to make light of a 3 lb rise for his most recent Lingfield victory and complete a hat-trick. Course winner Campani also bids for a third success of 2026 and seems sure to be on the premises, while Shes Got The Blues and King David, who came home 1-2 here recently, are also well in the mix.

runners.note: Doubled his tally for 2026 at Lingfield (7f, all-weather) in August. Posted a good second of 13 in handicap at Yarmouth (7f, good) 11 days ago so this veteran C&D scorer needs considering off an unchanged mark.

Ex-Irish recruit. On the up for his new yard, and landed a pair of 7f all-weather handicaps at Lingfield recently. Up another 3 lb but scored comfortably on latter occasion and weighted to complete a quick hat-trick.

Finally got off the mark at Bath (5f) in June and gained a second success here (6f, good to firm) in August. Rare below-par effort under softer ground conditions when twelfth of 17 in handicap returned to Bath 15 days ag

Very good third in 7f Kempton maiden on return in May for Michael Bell. Hasn't kicked on from that, though not given a hard time of it on stable debut when sixth of 10 in handicap at Lingfield (7f, all-weather) 25 days a

Habitual slow starter but he is enjoying a good 2026, gaining a second win at Yarmouth (1m) in July. Very good second of 11 back there (7f, good) last time. This course scorer is a likely player nudged up 1 lb.
Gained a first victory in first-time cheekpieces over C&D in August. Back to form with fourth of 13 in handicap at Yarmouth (7f, good) 11 days ago. Should remain competitive eased 1 lb.

Bagged a third win (one over C&D) this season in 1m handicap here in September. Followed it with a good third of 11 in handicap at Bath (1m, good to firm) 16 days ago. Can go well again off an unchanged mark.

Sole win came in 2024 but he arrives in very good nick, second of 9 to Shes Got The Blues in handicap here (1m, good) last time when making his effort earlier than ideal. Very much one to consider nudged up 1 lb.
Got off the mark for the season in 7f Salisbury handicap in July. Two poor runs in 1m handicaps there and at Bath have followed though. This dual C&D scorer needs to get back on track.
Still a maiden but she recorded good efforts when placed at Wolverhampton (7f) and over C&D this summer. Run best ignored (suffered interference) at Lingfield (6f, all-weather) last time.
Got off the mark over C&D in August and has continued in good form when in the frame over C&D and fourth of 6 in 7f Kempton handicap. One to consider.
Resumed winning ways in classified event over C&D in June but not been in same form since, beating only one in similar company back over C&D last time. Cheekpieces are retried now.

races.name: Ballymore Group Irish EBF Kilbegnet Novice Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict: A Grade 3 winner over hurdles, DADDY LONG LEGS jumped well in the main when making a successful chasing debut in good style at Killarney and he looks to hold leading claims with progress to come. C&D winner Wild Bill Hickok is better than he could show last time and is the pick for second, ahead of Femme Magnifique.

runners.note: Smart form over hurdles, runner-up in the Irish Champion Hurdle last year. Placed in a couple of maidens on the Flat this summer, before scoring with a fair bit in hand on chasing debut in maiden at Killarney last month.

Dual winning hurdler in France who won 2 of first 3 starts over fences for current yard, scoring by a wide margin in maiden at Wexford in May and novice over this C&D the following month. Failed to give his running in Gr

Had taken well to chasing prior to unseating at the Galway Festival, but soon got back on the up when winning handicap at Tramore (2¾m) 6 weeks ago. However, was allowed to build up a big lead last time, so faces a tough
Much improved this season for new yard, winning twice in handicaps at around 2m and adding a novice success at Wexford (2½m) a month ago. Back up in grade but she can go well in her hat-trick bid.

Fairly useful hurdler for Peter Fahey but showed her quirky side in her 4 outings last year. Possibly needed the run after 11 months off when well-beaten fourth of 7 in mares maiden at Tramore (2¾m) on chasing/stable deb

races.name: Phoenix Drilling Ground Investigation Handicap
races.verdict: IMPRESSOR landed a bit of a touch in the mud over C&D 8 days ago and remaining well treated on old form carrying a 4-lb penalty, Phillip Makin's veteran gets the vote to follow up. Vince l'Amour has never been one for maximum faith, but he can provide most resistance if on a going day, with Supremissy, who finished close behind the selection last time, rounding off the shortlist.

runners.note: Won 5 times over the minimum trip in 2025. Hasn't fired this season though, including in reapplied blinkers at Haydock on Saturday.

Well placed/drawn when opening her account for the year at Ayr last month and was an excellent close second of 20 back there (5f, soft) 11 days ago. Not so good here (6f, soft) 3 days later, however, and forced to race f

Runner-up 3 times on the spin before getting off the mark at Thirsk (6f) in early August. Only beaten 2 lengths when keen enough on final start for Gary Harrison at Newcastle earlier in the month but made a low-key start
Up-and-down performer who ran one of this season's better races when sixth of 20 at Ayr (5f, soft) 11 days ago. Not sure to be in same form here.

Bounced back to form to get off the mark at the eleventh time of asking in 12-runner event at Carlisle (5f, good to soft) earlier in the month. Not the same form as last time having faced competition for the lead at Newc

Veteran who has come good at this time of year once again, landing a gamble when beating Supremissy by ½ length in the mud over C&D 8 days ago. Carries a 4-lb penalty and fancied to be in the shake-up once again.

Improved to make a successful handicap debut at Musselburgh in June and having largely struggled since, got back to best and confirmed herself effective on testing ground when second of 8 to Impressor over C&D 8 days ago

Isn't the force of old but has placed in a couple of handicaps off much-reduced mark this summer. Well held in a higher grade than necessary at Ayr 11 days ago and others preferred kept to this company.

races.name: Par Inn Bulpin Cup Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: POOROLDMACKLEY has been shaping up well under his regular amateur rider and looks capable of getting off the mark for the year. Bits Ballou, Ask Peter and Poet's Muse appeal most of the remainder.

runners.note: Sligo maiden hurdle winner whose form went the wrong way (including over fences) for Eric McNamara in Ireland. British mark looks stiff enough, even if back on song for new handler.

Doubled his career/course tally when a narrow winner in first-time visor over C&D in June. Hasn't bettered that form with a couple of in-frame efforts at Worcester since and a 1-lb reprieve probably isn't enough.

Point winner. Allowed the run of things when pushing a fair sort from the Paul Nicholls yard close on handicap debut at Taunton in April. Didn't repeat that effort the following month, however, worth a second look return

Successful over fences here last year. Back on his latest winning mark and has looked in top form recently. Again finished with running left under an overly patient ride when 2½-length second at Plumpton 8 days ago. Capa

Hasn't kicked on since going close in a 2m handicap here in June, however, is on a reasonable mark if revitalised by this marked step up in trip (stayed well on the Flat). She looks an uncomplicated ride for her relative

Lightly-raced mare. Best effort came when 2¼-length second of 5 (ahead of Final Entry) in a slowly-run event over C&D on handicap bow. Well below form behind French Diablo (2¾m) subsequently. Step back up in trip/stable'

Lightly-raced 4-y-o. Hasn't progressed since his breakthrough success in a weak race at Stratford (2¾m). First-time cheekpieces added and has work to do from out of the handicap, even with yard's amateur claiming 7 lb.

races.name: Pravha Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict: AUGUSTA ROCK has shown enough previously to be competitive at this level and can open his account. Ballaghkeen caught the eye on her reappearance at Navan and can step up on that, with Flagstone Lady another to consider on the back of her recent course success.

runners.note: Strong in the betting and confirmed previous promise when getting off the mark in 13-runner handicap at this course (13f, good) 24 days ago, well on top finish. An 11 lb rise makes things harder but she has few miles on

Lightly-raced maiden. Attracted support after 11 months off and caught eye when sixth of 21 in handicap at Navan (1¼m, good, 11/1) 23 days ago, left with too much to do. Can build on that and she remains capable of bette
Represents top connections but has yet to cut much ice. Significantly up in trip.
Runner-up twice this season, latest here earlier this month. Finished well held back on the all-weather at Dundalk on Friday and needs to bounce back.
Lightly-raced maiden. 25/1, tenth of 15 on nursery debut at Galway (7f, heavy), going off too hard. Significantly up in trip and can only be watched after 11 months off.
Lightly-raced maiden who's run to a modest level on last 4 starts. Takes a step up in trip and needs to find improvement to be involved.
Is yet to make any impact from 5 outings and is hard to make a case for even with the blinkers added.
A 4-time winner on the all-weather who hasn't threatened on the turf this season. Others more persuasive.

Took another step forward in a change of headgear (first-time blinkers) when second here in July but wasn't in the same form at Roscommon the following month. The visor goes back on and has to be taken seriously if bounc
Respectable fourth of 21 in handicap at Navan (1¼m, good, 28/1) 23 days ago. Has a poor strike rate and it remains to be seen if she can back that up.
22/1, creditable sixth of 22 in handicap at Navan (1¾m, good) 32 days ago, having to pick way through. Down in trip and cheekpieces are now added.
Ex-Polish 7f winner. Yet to fire for current yard and probably needed run at Navan earlier this month after 4 months off. Easy to look elsewhere.
Course winner who also scored at Dundalk last winter but it has been all downhill since. Makes little appeal.
Poor maiden looking pretty exposed by now and it's hard to see her making a serious impact.

Right back on her game when fourth over hurdles at Galway in July. May have found race coming too soon back on the level 2 weeks later but given a short break since. Engaged 5.30 Curragh Sunday. RESERVE.

races.name: Download The At The Races App Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A good novice. NAJIDI STORM may have simply got stuck in the mud at Goodwood and has to be worth another chance given how promising his all-weather debut success was. Wootz also looks decidedly useful and is feared most ahead of Shadow Boxer, who has been off since his promising debut third in the spring.

runners.note: Night of Thunder gelding who was second on his Southwell debut last month and made the most of a good opportunity at Redcar (1m, good) since. This is a lot harder but there should be more to come.

Brother to St Leger winner Logician and smart 9f-1¾m winner Collide. Looked a smart prospect when seeing off Gavriel on his 1m Kempton debut and may have simply failed to handle heavy ground when becoming the shortest-pr

Wootton Bassett colt who stormed clear for an impressive debut success at Ffos Las (1m, good) last month. Beaten at short odds but still stepped up on that form when second to another good prospect at Windsor (1m, good a

Standout effort over hurdles when fourth at Leopardstown on final start for Emmet Mullins last December. Didn't achieve much when third of 4 on recent Ffos Las Flat debut for new yard last Monday. Can only watch.
Ulysses gelding who was beaten a long way in 2 turf outings last month and is unlikely to be of any interest this side of handicaps.
Kameko gelding. Half-brother to 1m winner Sold Out. Dam, 6f winner (including at 2 yrs), half-sister to useful 9f-1¼m winner (stayed 1½m) Stylehunter. Likely outsider on belated debut.
$20,000 Tonalist colt. Dam lightly-raced US maiden half-sister to US winner around 5f (including at 2 yrs) Salmanazar. Wears blinkers for this belated debut. Could only consider if backed.
Showed ability in good races at Newmarket and Newbury in the spring for Andrew Balding. With a new yard back from 136 days off (gelded).
€400,000 Frankel colt but last of 15 on 7f Newbury debut in the spring and off since (gelded).

€520,000 Too Darn Hot colt who shaped encouragingly amidst greenness when third of 12 in novice at Southwell (1m) on debut in April. Has a tongue tied added back from 166 days off (gelded). Likely improver under Murphy.
More one for low-grade handicaps based on her 2 runs over the summer.

races.name: Download The Matchbook Exchange App Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: MACANUDO has been firmly in the groove since the blinkers went back on and is fancied to defy a 3-lb rise and gain a quick hat-trick here at the chief expense of the consistent My Mate Mackley, who looks set to extend his run of solid in-frame efforts. In-form duo Port Hedland and Nordic Glory can also play a prominent role in this very open-looking handicap.

runners.note: Back in fine form since refitted with blinkers and bids for a hat-trick after 5f handicap successes at Wolverhampton and Bath recently, getting on top late on both occasions. Up 3 lb but can go very well again.
Unreliable individual but doubled his tally for the season at Bath in July. Posted a solid fifth of 17 in another handicap there last time. Can't be ruled out in current mood.
Made a winning start in handicaps at Lingfield (5f, all-weather) in August but finished last of 8 back there (5f) 18 days ago. This is easier and she was successful on her only other go on turf.
On a long losing sequence but several good in-frame efforts (including here) this year until a below-par fifth of 12 at Wolverhampton (6f) last time. Should bounce back.

Gained a second win in classified company at Lingfield (6f) in August. Has run well to be in the frame all 4 runs since, fourth of 12 in 6f handicap at Southwell 6 days ago. A player off an unchanged mark with usual chee

Opened his account for the year in classified race at Bath in June. Not disgraced over C&D and when a close sixth of 8 in handicap at Bath (5.7f, good to firm) last 2 runs. Well in the mix with hood back on.
Winless since going in over 5f here last June and he came in last of 11 in classified event over C&D in June. Needs to get back on track after a break.
Remains a maiden after 29 runs. Not at his best of late too, going too freely in a change of headgear when sixth of 9 in handicap at Bath (5.7f, good to firm) 26 days ago.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Handicap Chase
races.verdict: LADIES WELL has shown improved form sent chasing this season, landing 2 handicaps and continuing in good heart when never-nearer fourth at Ballinrobe 17 days ago. She is taken to resume winning ways, at the expense of the in-form Chosen Shant and handicap-debutant Jolie Jewel.

runners.note: Fortunate to double her tally over fences at Limerick (25f) in May. However, has been let down by her jumping when failing to complete both outings since, pulled up at Tramore 6 weeks ago. Cheekpieces reached for.

Fairly useful winning hurdler who has matched that form in 4 starts over fences this season, 1½ lengths third of 7 in maiden at Ballinrobe (23f) 5 weeks ago. Interesting as she makes handicap chase debut.

Best effort over fences when runner-up in mares maiden at Tramore (2m) in May. Hasn't kicked on from that effort since, though, well-beaten fourth of 5 in novice at Wexford last time. Cheekpieces applied for handicap cha

Versatile performer who won over 2m on the Flat this summer. Creditable fourth of 6 in handicap chase at Wexford (2m) next outing, but added to this season's patchy record back hurdling when well held at Listowel (2¼m) 8

Bumper/hurdles winner and ran to a similar level when making the frame in mares maidens on first 2 starts over fences. Form has been mixed in 3 subsequent outings, though, not jumping well when pulled up in handicap at P

Fairly useful hurdler, landing a Kilbeggan handicap (3m) in June. However, she's still looking for a first win over fences, making little impact tried in tongue strap when fifth of 9 in mares maiden at Ballinrobe (23f) 1

Both hurdles wins at Wexford and has scored in 2 handicap chases there this season, the latest over 19f last month. Back hurdling, again ran well when sixth of 18 in mares handicap at Listowel 8 days ago. Not taken light

Has taken well to chasing this season, winning 23f handicaps at Killarney in July and August (runner-up at this course in between). Shaped as if still in top form when fourth of 16 at Ballinrobe last time, left with too

Off the mark on second run for this stable in mares handicap hurdle at Listowel (2m) in June. However, has gone backwards from that effort in 2 chase starts since, pulled up in handicap at Killarney last time.

Runner-up 4 times in handicap hurdles in 2025/26. Yet to fire this season, though, including on second chase start when mid-field in handicap at Downpatrick (24f) in June. Fared little better back hurdling at the same ve

races.name: Annual Members Of Hamilton Park Handicap
races.verdict: It's hard to have much faith in a 21-race maiden but OFF SPIN has been knocking at the door this season and having shaped better than the bare result at Ayr recently, he's afforded the tentative vote. Jim Goldie looks to have a strong hand with Uncle Liam and Storm on Jura so they're feared most, with Hickton another to consider from a much-reduced mark, as well.

runners.note: Hasn't won since his juvenile days and little to shout about over hurdles for new connections this season, most recently after a second breathing operation. Did go close from this mark when last seen on the level for Tim

Opened account over this C&D in June and forged clear to double his tally here (11f, soft) earlier in the month. Sent off a short-priced favourite but could only manage third of 6 over C&D 8 days ago. Should go well agai

Landed this corresponding race last year and resumed winning ways at Southwell (1¾m) in April. Has largely struggled since but back on song with a couple of third-placed efforts in recent weeks. One to consider from this

Long-standing maiden but did shape better than the distance beaten suggested when fifth of 10 at Ayr (13f, soft) 10 days ago, still going best when on the shoulder of the leader around 2f out but not able to sustain his

Gained a first win at Pontefract in July and runner-up twice at odds on his next 2 starts. Threw in a modest display despite getting an easy time of things in front at Carlisle (11f, good to firm) last month so needs to

Gained a first win at Wolverhampton in April but having had a breathing operation, was never going to see things out having been even keener than usual back from 3 months off at same course in late-July. Handicapper drop

Still a maiden but again saw the trip out well when fourth of 13 in handicap at Windsor (11.4f, good to soft) last month. May benefit from being ridden more prominently now and could take another step forward.
Remains a maiden but ran best race under more testing conditions than usual when second of 6 over C&D (soft) 8 days ago. Every chance of going one better under the same rider.
Winless from 10 starts but turned in best effort of the season returned to the scene of her best 2-y-o run when fifth of 10 at Beverley (8.5f, good) 12 days ago. Significantly back up in trip.
Tailed off in 3 Dundalk maidens last winter. Makes handicap debut upped markedly in trip and worth a second look in the betting for her top yard.

races.name: Molson Coors Beverage Handicap
races.verdict: RAKKI stepped up on his reappearance to open his account on the level at Tramore just over 6 weeks ago and far from handicapped out of things from 4 lb higher, Willie Mullins' 5-y-o gets the verdict to follow up. Flying Fortress is knocking at the door so he can provide most resistance, with Nod of Approval and Sarangpur another couple worthy of consideration, too.

runners.note: Last success came at Roscommon in 2024. stepped up on a low-key first run of the summer on the Flat when second of 14 in maiden hurdle at Wexford back in early-August and task is to back that up returned to the level.
